title: Solution Architect - Data
description:
Role Overview Experienced Senior Solution Architect Data to lead the design and governance of enterprise-wide data platforms and analytics solutions. Lead design and optimisation of the data ecosystem for a large engineering enterprise with a diverse application landscape that includes multiple ERPs (Baan, Oracle, SAP), cloud platforms, and SaaS solutions. Demonstrated technical expertise with strong architectural leadership are a must for the role. Key Responsibilities Define and govern the enterprise data architecture, ensuring alignment with business strategy and IT standards. Design end-to-end data solutions across ingestion, storage, modelling, analytics, and governance layers, especially focussed on leveraging Azure and Databricks as strategic platforms. Develop strategies to unify data from multiple ERPs (Baan, Oracle, SAP) and cloud/SaaS systems into a data lake platform. Establish information architecture, metadata management, and data quality frameworks. Collaborate with business stakeholders, and development teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. Provide thought leadership on emerging data technologies and how they can create business value. Support governance processes for change management, security, compliance, and lifecycle management of data assets. Required Skills & Experience Proven track record as a Data/Analytics Solution Architect in complex enterprise environments with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and information architecture. Experience architecting solutions using Azure data services and Databricks (e.g., Synapse Analytics, Data Lake, Azure SQL, Data Factory, Spark, and Delta Lake) for large-scale data engineering and advanced analytics. Experience in implementing data governance, security, and regulatory compliance practices. At least 7 years of experience of architecting on premise and cloud data solutions in Finance and Supplychain domains.

Key Skills: Data Warehousing,Solution Architect,DataBricks,Azure Synapse,Azure Data Factory,Azure,Datafactory,Data Lake

title: Dot Technical Architect
description:
.NET Technical Engineering Manager Location: Pune Experience: 1120 Years Employment Type : Full-Time Team Handling: Required About the Role We are looking for an experienced .NET Technical Architect with 10 - 20 years of software development and architecture experience to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in the Microsoft technology stack, hands-on architecture experience, and proven team handling and technical leadership capabilities. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, QA, DevOps, and business teams to define technical solutions, establish development best practices, and drive successful delivery of complex software projects. Key Responsibilities Define and own the technical architecture with team handling experience for scalable, secure, and high-performance .NET applications. Lead the design and development of enterprise applications using C#, .NET Core/.NET 6+ and ASP.NET Core. Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions. Lead and mentor a team of developers, providing technical direction, code reviews, and architectural guidance. Manage technical deliverables, task allocation, technical risks, and dependencies within the team. Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and enterprise applications. Define coding standards, design principles, architecture guidelines, and development best practices. Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure quality, scalability, maintainability, and security. Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders. Identify technical challenges and provide effective solutions for complex problems. Drive modernization, performance optimization, refactoring, and migration initiatives. Provide technical estimates and contribute to project planning and resource planning. Support CI/CD, cloud adoption, containerization, and DevOps initiatives. Ensure applications follow security, reliability, performance, and compliance standards. Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend suitable technology adoption. Mandatory Technical Skills 1120 years of experience in software development with strong expertise in Microsoft .NET technologies. Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET Core/.NET 6+. Excellent knowledge of ASP.NET Core, Web API and REST services. Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, Design Patterns, and Clean Architecture. Experience designing microservices and distributed applications. Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database design, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization. Experience with Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core. Good understanding of authentication and authorization, preferably OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and JWT. Experience with Azure/AWS or other cloud platforms. Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes is preferred. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Good understanding of Git and modern software development practices. Experience with application performance, scalability, logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Team Leadership & Management Proven experience handling and mentoring technical teams. Ability to lead teams of developers and provide technical ownership. Experience conducting technical interviews and evaluating engineering talent. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to resolve technical conflicts and drive consensus on architecture decisions. Experience in sprint planning, technical task allocation, estimation, and delivery tracking. Ability to build a strong engineering culture focused on quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. Preferred Skills Experience with Azure services, Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, Service Bus, or similar cloud technologies. Knowledge of Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch, or other distributed technologies. Experience with React, Angular, or other modern frontend technologies. Knowledge of event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing. Experience with system integration and third-party APIs. Understanding of application security and secure coding practices. Exposure to AI/GenAI integration within enterprise applications is an added advantage. 
 Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 Key Competencies Technical Architecture & Solution Design Team Leadership & Mentoring .NET / C# Development Microservices & Distributed Systems Cloud & DevOps Database Architecture Performance & Scalability Problem Solving Stakeholder Management Technical Communication

Key Skills: C#,.NET,.NET Core,AI,.NET Architecture,Core,Artificial Intelligence,Technical
